name: session-scan13
about: Phase S of the attended wifi-bench-session: PD4 golden boot -> ready -> ctx_create t1 -> txq_sync72 -> iw iface add wlan0 type managed (provider user_add g0 id7/id8) -> link up -> ONE 13-channel iw scan (provider vap_add g0 id1 + vap_start g0 id1 + scan_req g0 id0xC 520 B) -> firmware answers with g1 id17 channel results + g1 id15 beacons, the scan-complete decoder builds cfg80211 BSS entries. PASS gates: chans=13/13 + finish-ok + results/bss >0 + iw output BSS lines + mask/staging 0 + page/state golden + no provider refusal. Requires the scan-complete provider module (748,888 B b42ff4ec / alt 748,564 B 02162d4a), scan_timeout_ms=60000 (clamped 45000), allow_frames=16, vap_start_mode=1.

steps.name: note-ladder
steps.about: Phase S ladder: hardware-validated D2 machinery (2026-11-26 fires) on the scan-complete provider module. The scan timeout is the manual 60 s request; the module clamps it to 45 s (HI5622_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS). At the measured ~3.5 s/channel pace 13 channels need ~45.5 s, so a 12/13 cut at the clamp is the documented possible outcome - it is a STOP result for this lane, not a silent pass.

steps.name: cfg-status
steps.about: wiphy registered after the ready handshake (the cfg80211 preamble already waits for /sys/class/ieee80211; this is the sequence-local re-gate)

steps.name: pre-pack
steps.about: pre-create state on this fresh boot: no context (ctx4+0x190 = 0), exception mask 0, exception staging word 0

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: prerequisite 1/2: ONE context-create H2D (g0 id1 key 0x64, data[0]=type 1) - the 2026-11-26 mode-1 bench ladder had this consumed in 0 polls before the scan

steps.name: post-create
steps.about: the create allocated the measured ctx4 body (same PACK as C2: ctx4[0]=4, ctx4+0x10=0x00010001, ctx4+0x434=0x0100478C)

steps.name: txq-sync72
steps.about: prerequisite 2/2: ONE TXQ config sync H2D (g0 id1 cmd 0xd8, 72-byte node) -> the core is ACTIVE before the provider VAP/scan sequence (vap_start_first=1)

steps.name: post-txq
steps.about: the TXQ handler ran clean: exception mask and staging word stay 0

steps.name: vap-add
steps.about: iw phy phy0 interface add wlan0 type managed -> add_virtual_intf -> provider user_add g0 id7 180 B + user_add_notify g0 id8 180 B (hardware: 1/12 + 2/12 consumed). A user_add post failure keeps the netdev live and is caught by the frame_post gate below

steps.name: link-up
steps.about: bring the managed netdev up; nl80211 refuses scan requests on a down interface

steps.name: vap-added
steps.about: the driver VAP model recorded wlan0 (real netdev); the provider user frames are gated by the post-scan frame_post counters

steps.name: catalog-baseline
steps.about: D2H catalogue before the scan request (evidence baseline: no scan-event family present yet)

steps.name: scan
steps.about: ONE nl80211 scan request over all 13 channels of the 2.4 GHz band: the provider posts vap_add g0 id1 48 B + vap_start g0 id1 40 B + scan_req g0 id0xC 520 B, the firmware reports every scanned channel (g1 id17) and its beacons (g1 id15). iw blocks until scan_done; the driver's bound is scan_timeout_ms=60000 clamped to 45000 by the module (HI5622_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS). The host driver additionally checks that the captured iw output contains BSS lines - a PASS needs real cfg80211 BSS entries.

steps.name: scan-settle
steps.about: bounded settle for the last scan events + cfg80211 BSS informs before the evidence reads

steps.name: scan-dmesg
steps.about: evidence capture: at least one per-channel g1 id17 decode line and the scan DONE summary must exist (the verdict gates below decide PASS/STOP)

steps.name: scan-status
steps.about: evidence capture: the scan model reached the finished phase; chans/finish detail is read from the same line and gated below

steps.name: post-scan-pack
steps.about: hard firmware-health gate before the verdict: no exception after the 13-channel ladder

steps.name: post-scan-page
steps.about: hard gate: the PD4 golden handshake page and boot state survived the scan

steps.name: scan-13ch-gate
steps.about: PASS gate: full 13-channel coverage AND host/firmware success finish. A partial scan (e.g. 12/13 at the 45 s clamp) or a host-timeout abort is a STOP for this lane, never BLOCKED: the experiment's whole subject is the 13/13 bound.

steps.name: scan-results-gate
steps.about: PASS gate: results/bss counts non-zero (the firmware answered with channel results and the beacon decoder produced BSS entries)

steps.name: frame-post
steps.about: the provider wire path accepted every ladder frame (2 user_add + vap_add + vap_start + scan_req) with no refusal/timeout; exact posted count captured in evidence

steps.name: h2d-summary
steps.about: the two prerequisite H2D frames (ctx_create + txq_sync72) were consumed and none was refused

steps.name: catalog-after
steps.about: watch/evidence: D2H catalogue after the 13-channel scan (g1 id17 channel results and g1 id15 beacons; BSS IE decode already happened in the driver)

steps.name: vap-del
steps.about: tear the managed VAP down after the verdict; a teardown failure after green scan gates is recorded, not a verdict change

steps.name: note-end
steps.about: Phase S PASS = session PASS + iw output contains BSS lines (host gate) + chans=13/13 + finish-ok + results>0 + mask/staging 0 + page golden/state 1 + provider refused/timeout 0. STOP on any hard gate: capture everything, power-cycle, analyse offline - never retry the scan on the same boot.
